issue.title: gui: the sidebar's gateway line keeps the old port after Settings › Gateway address › Apply
issue.body:
Found while reviewing #3429. On origin/main b1f44d099, the sidebar's gateway line at the foot of the window keeps showing the old port after **Settings › Network › Gateway address › Apply** moves the gateway. It is corrected only by a reload or by something else that reads the providers again.

## Reproduce

I used the dev build in a sandbox HOME, with `port: 3483` in settings.json, no MAGPIE_ADDR and MAGPIE_DEV_UI=127.0.0.1:3484. Then, in Playwright (Chromium), I opened `?view=settings&tab=network`, typed 3486 and pressed Apply:

```
start: Gateway 127.0.0.1:3483
after Apply: Gateway 127.0.0.1:3483 | settings says: ... Now http://127.0.0.1:3486
after reload: Gateway 127.0.0.1:3486
```

With #3429's change (c28576084) the result is the same: 3481 → 3485, and the line still says 3481 until a reload.

## Cause

The port save handler in app.js (`renderPort`'s `save.onclick`, the `settings/port` call) calls `renderSettings()` only. `sideGwAt` (the line's state) comes from the providers read, or now from boot.js, and nothing updates it after the move. `res.settings.gateway` already carries the new URL.

## Why it isn't in the #3429 commit

app.js is at its budget (TestCoreScriptBudget, 1,321,424 on main, with 25 bytes left after #3429). The fix (`renderSideGw` with `res.settings.gateway` after the save) needs room, which means moving something out of app.js first. Raising the budget is not the fix.

comments.body:
Delivered on `fix/sidebar-gateway-line` ([7597f816](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/7597f816), skygunner's fork, on upstream/main 641b1217): the port save draws the sidebar's line from the move's own answer — `renderSideGw({url: res.settings.gateway, running: true})` beside `renderSettings()` — instead of leaving it at what the providers read had said.

One disclosure, in the interest of clean attribution: this fix was committed on the same working branch as my #3530 fix before I split it, so `fix/sidebar-gateway-line` and `fix/codex-multi-home-sessions` share that stretch of history on the fork (my mistake, not re-done with a force-push). The two commits touch disjoint files and each cherry-picks alone: 7597f816 is this fix (gui/app.js, i18n.js, tests), 8b9022cd is #3530's (internal/sessions).

The room the fix needed came the way the issue asked, not by raising the budget: `portSays` — the three vendor sentences matched by their own words, which is a translation's job — moved to i18n.js (not counted by the budget, and where matching a vendor's words belongs), giving 605 bytes for the fix's 168. `TestCoreScriptBudget` holds: app.js 1,321,347 of 1,321,424.

Red before: `side-gw-port-move.test.cjs`, Chromium and WebKit, English and Chinese — after Apply the line read "Gateway 127.0.0.1:3483" (网关 127.0.0.1:3483) with the gateway on 3486; after, 3486, the old port gone. sidebar.test.cjs and api-key-theme.test.cjs fail as they do on the untouched upstream main (12 reds, shown on a clean checkout — pre-existing, not from this change).

**Pickup note (10-25):** this fix alone is on `fix/sidebar-gateway-line-standalone-1025` ([71d5d7c0](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/71d5d7c0)) - 7597f816 cherry-picked onto clean upstream main 641b1217, gui/app.js, i18n.js and the test only, nothing of #3530 - verified at that head: TestCoreScriptBudget holds, the Playwright test is 4/4 in Chromium and WebKit, en and zh, and the sidebar/api-key-theme reds are the same twelve the untouched main shows.

issue.title: sessions: Codex thread names and sqlite_home are read from CODEX_HOME only, not its other folders

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Sibling of the fix for Codex's other folders (phantom3792 on X: sessions and quota of accounts kept under another `CODEX_HOME`, such as `~/.codex-work`).

Rollouts, the usage ledger and the accounts now read every Codex folder (`appdir.CodexHomes`). Two readers still go by `CodexHome` alone:

- **Thread names.** `codexTitleIndexPath()` in `internal/sessions/codex_titles.go` reads only `$CODEX_HOME/session_index.jsonl`. A session in another folder shows its first prompt, not the name the user gave it in Codex. The `codexTitles` cache holds one path, so reading several folders needs a cache for each path.
- **State databases.** `codexStateDBs(home)` in `internal/sessions/codex_provider.go` honours `config.toml`'s `sqlite_home` only when `home == CodexDir()`. An extra folder that sets `sqlite_home` has its state DB looked for in the folder itself.

issue.title: 设置页打开时刷新，侧边栏底部的网关地址会慢一拍才出现

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### 复现

窗口里按 **Cmd+R** 刷新：页面内容几乎立即出现，但侧边栏底部的网关行（"网关 127.0.0.1:3425"）晚一拍才出现——设置页开不开都会发生，设置页开着时更明显。实测（正在运行的 app，无障碍快照连拍）：Cmd+R 后页面主体在第一次快照已在，网关行在约 1.6 秒的连续快照里都不存在，之后才出现，与下面的 1500ms 定时器 + providers 读取链路吻合。

### 根因

- `#sideGw` 默认 hidden，只有 `renderSideGw()` 拿到 providers 数据才显示（`internal/gui/assets/app.js`）。
- 这份读取挂在启动后 1500ms 的定时器上（`sideGwRead`），而 providers 的读取要等 `/api/state` 里 agents 探测完成（#1519 的一读两用）。所以每次刷新，这行都要等 1500ms 加上 agents 探测的时长，和设置页开不开无关。
- 设置页打开时，`loadSettings()` 的系统字体枚举、`/api/settings` 的 Launch Services 终端枚举（macOS）和设置页的大 DOM 构建压在同一个启动窗口上，把延迟拉得更长，更容易被注意到。

### 已准备的参考

- [单个提交 c1f457a](https://github.com/chiperman/magpie/commit/c1f457a1b4a72049aa5c17a035a17ce24f0e8f50)
- [与上游的差异](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/compare/main...chiperman:magpie:codex/side-gateway-from-boot)

改动只有 3 个文件、约 19 行：

1. `internal/gui/api.go:839` boot.js handler 在本进程确实服务网关时（`served.Load() != nil`）附带 `sideGateway: {url}`。网关地址启动时已确定（`gateway.URL()`），boot.js 又在首帧前加载。用独立键 `sideGateway`，不占用已表示 gateway 模式的 `boot.gateway`；另一 magpie 进程服务网关时不下发，运行状态仍由 providers 读取判断。
2. `internal/gui/assets/app.js:24925` 新增 `renderSideGwBoot()`，侧边栏初始化时从 `bootPrefs.sideGateway` 立即渲染该行并缓存；1500ms 的 providers 读取照旧待命，一读仍服务两处。
3. `internal/gui/tests/sidebar.test.cjs` boot fixture 加 `sideGateway`，断言从"等待出现"改为"启动即可见"（旧代码上为红，红→绿验证过）。

### 已跑 / 未跑

在 `a93190ae`（origin/main）上：

- 已跑：`sidebar.test.cjs` 在 chromium 与 webkit 全过；在旧 `app.js` 上新断言为红；`refresh-page`、`side-toggle`、`gateway-port` 回归通过（chromium）；`node --check` 语法校验。另在正在运行的 app 上实测确认了上述复现（Cmd+R 后页面先出现、网关行晚约一拍半）。
- **未跑**：Go 侧构建/测试（本机没有 Go 工具链，`internal/gui/api.go` 的改动需要你在有 Go 的环境补跑）。

谢谢！

issue.title: privacy model: its download ignores Settings' Proxy (fails where a proxy is the only way out)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
# privacy model: its download ignores Settings' Proxy

## What happens

On a machine whose only way out is a proxy, Settings → Privacy's local model fails to turn on:

```
downloading pf-serve: https://github.com/yetone/magpie/releases/download/pf-v1/pf-serve-linux-amd64.zip:
Get "https://release-assets.githubusercontent.com/github-production-release-asset/…":
net/http: TLS handshake timeout
```

Settings' Proxy is set (`socks5h://192.168.1.233:1081`) and works — the very same URL through it
downloads in 6 seconds. Turning the model on again fails the same way, this time as a plain
`dial tcp <github ip>:443: i/o timeout`, so the request never goes near the proxy.

The model (huggingface.co) would fail the same way on such a network, so the feature cannot be
turned on at all.

## Why

`internal/pii/fetch.go` builds its client at package init:

```go
var client = func() *http.Client {
	t := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
	t.ResponseHeaderTimeout = 60 * time.Second
	return &http.Client{Transport: t}
}()
```

`netproxy.Install()` — which sets `http.DefaultTransport.Proxy = netproxy.Func`, the thing that makes
every other request of magpie's follow Settings' Proxy — runs later, from `main`
(`internal/cli/main.go`). The clone is made before it, so it keeps `http.ProxyFromEnvironment`,
which in the app and in the container has nothing to read. Both downloads therefore go direct,
whatever Settings say. (`source.Do` still asks mirrors when it can, but the zip's only mirror is
`gh-proxy`, which is behind `MAGPIE_MIRRORS=on`, so it changes nothing here.)

## Fix

`internal/update/update.go` already has the shape for exactly this:

```go
func proxied() http.RoundTripper {
	t := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
	t.Proxy = netproxy.Func
	return netproxy.Dispatch(t)
}
```

so `internal/pii/fetch.go` can do the same (with `github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/netproxy`
imported):

```go
var client = func() *http.Client {
	t := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
	t.Proxy = netproxy.Func // Settings' Proxy, as every other request of magpie's
	t.ResponseHeaderTimeout = 60 * time.Second
	return &http.Client{Transport: t}
}()
```

Then both downloads follow Settings' Proxy (and its LAN bypass), `MAGPIE_MIRRORS=on` still gives the
`gh-proxy` fallback, and the checksums stay as they are — a mirror or a proxy is only the way there.

## Workaround (no rebuild)

Put the two files where the download would have put them, then turn the model on again — it is
judged by what is on disk, so no restart is needed:

```
<cache>/privacy-filter/pf-v1-linux-amd64/   ← the zip's contents, pf-serve executable
<cache>/privacy-filter/privacy-filter-q8-80efc1803eda.gguf
```

where `<cache>` is `~/.cache/magpie` (app, `XDG_CACHE_HOME` respected) or `/config/cache/magpie`
(the container image). The zip is `pf-serve-linux-amd64.zip` from the `pf-v1` release
(sha256 `b172f39b2b5446cb92ef14f996b65157f5e1c0e4e673ee9c61a0214cc67c78af`); the model is
`privacy-filter-q8.gguf` at revision `935d8688`
(sha256 `80efc1803eda7c095a79741d2008c07e2e0a57b01bac8825fbeb448fd097998c`, 1637572192 bytes).

## Environment

magpie v0.1.1471, server edition (the container image: `XDG_CACHE_HOME=/config/cache`),
linux-amd64, behind a proxy-only network.

## Patch

```diff
diff --git a/internal/pii/fetch.go b/internal/pii/fetch.go
index ed23cb59..ee85637b 100644
--- a/internal/pii/fetch.go
+++ b/internal/pii/fetch.go
@@ -16,6 +16,7 @@ import (
 	"sync/atomic"
 	"time"
 
+	"github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/netproxy"
 	"github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/source"
 )
 
@@ -33,6 +34,9 @@ var dl struct {
 // whose server doesn't answer by the header timeout.
 var client = func() *http.Client {
 	t := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
+	// through Settings' Proxy as every other request of magpie's is: the
+	// clone is made before netproxy.Install sets it on http.DefaultTransport
+	t.Proxy = netproxy.Func
 	t.ResponseHeaderTimeout = 60 * time.Second
 	return &http.Client{Transport: t}
 }()
```
